decisive_items: synovial thickening with hyperemia in the first, second, third, and fifth MTP joints of the right foot and the first and second MTP joints of the left foot
response.rationale: High-titer anti-CCP and RF, symmetric polyarthritis with tenosynovitis and MTP/MCP synovitis strongly favor RA despite absent personal/family history; enthesitis and tendon findings are secondary to inflammatory arthritis. Seronegative SpA is less likely given positive anti-CCP and symmetric small-joint involvement.

rejected.why: Enthesitis is a feature but not the overarching diagnosis; positive anti-CCP and polyarthritis point to RA.
Tendinitis is a local manifestation; systemic serology and polyarticular pattern indicate RA.
Tendinosis implies degenerative change, but active inflammation (power Doppler, elevated CRP/ESR) and serology favor RA.
Seronegative SpA typically lacks anti-CCP and symmetric small-joint synovitis; positive anti-CCP is decisive for RA.
